versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ci-cadastre-vertices: find or verify parcel vertex coordinates on the Cote d'Ivoire Mining Cadastre Map Portal.
- Supports searching by official parcel/license code and extracting boundary vertices using portal data.
- Prefers portal’s official Esri geometry; falls back to visual/manual reconstruction only if necessary.
- Converts and reports coordinates in both decimal degrees and DMS (if requested).
- Details all lookup steps and evidence for each result, specifying the source of geometry data.
